d: The theater represents a hall with two doors each door in front of the other and introducing into two bedrooms: table above which, bottles, bread, sausages etc. etc.. A closet, a screen, another table in a canton, above which porcelain cups for coffee, tea etc... At the bottom door to enter the shop. It leads straight, and to the left, which give communication to others, rooms, above the doorway a bell. All relatives, and Convitati of every sex, to the contract of marriage, who sits, who standing, eating, drinking. Spirition pours wine, now to this, now to that while singinging the following Chorus. Chorus; indi Don Hannibale.
